auth_sessions_subject.name: auth_sessions_subject
auth_sessions_subject.value:
("auth_sessions"."subject_type" = 'rider' and "auth_sessions"."rider_id" is not null and "auth_sessions"."staff_id" is null)
        or ("auth_sessions"."subject_type" = 'staff' and "auth_sessions"."staff_id" is not null and "auth_sessions"."rider_id" is null)

rider_contacts_value_format.name: rider_contacts_value_format
rider_contacts_value_format.value:
("rider_contacts"."kind" = 'email' and "rider_contacts"."value" = lower("rider_contacts"."value") and "rider_contacts"."value" like '%_@_%')
        or ("rider_contacts"."kind" = 'phone' and "rider_contacts"."value" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$')

pricing_plans_amounts.name: pricing_plans_amounts
pricing_plans_amounts.value:
"pricing_plans"."unlock_fee_santim" >= 0 and "pricing_plans"."per_minute_santim" >= 0 and "pricing_plans"."min_start_balance_santim" >= 0
        and "pricing_plans"."hold_amount_santim" >= 0 and coalesce("pricing_plans"."pause_per_minute_santim", 0) >= 0
        and coalesce("pricing_plans"."reservation_fee_santim", 0) >= 0 and "pricing_plans"."low_balance_floor_santim" <= 0

rides_completed_fields.name: rides_completed_fields
rides_completed_fields.value: "rides"."status" <> 'completed' or ("rides"."completed_at" is not null and "rides"."fare_santim" is not null)

payment_attempts_success_credited.name: payment_attempts_success_credited
payment_attempts_success_credited.value: "payment_attempts"."status" <> 'succeeded' or ("payment_attempts"."journal_id" is not null and "payment_attempts"."verified_at" is not null)
